title: Stowaway on the Hawk
summary: The Ebon Hawk's interior built into Anchorhead's docking bay, with KotOR II's Ebon Hawk lounge raised beside the customs post. A test scene for set pieces.
gmNotes: Walk the players around the ship, out across the docking bay floor where it joins, and up into the lounge. Right-click a set's floor to turn, raise, lower or remove it.

area.reason: Open docking bay floor for the ship to stand on.
